  - block_number: INTEGER
  - block_hash: STRING; semantics: LOWER(b.hash)
  - block_timestamp: TIMESTAMP
  - beneficiary_address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(b.miner)
  - gas_used: INTEGER
  - transaction_count: INTEGER
  - base_fee_per_gas_wei: INTEGER
Relation `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.contract_dimension`(end_date DATE)
  - address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(c.address)
  - is_erc20: BOOLEAN
  - is_erc721: BOOLEAN
  - created_at: TIMESTAMP
  - block_number: INTEGER
  - block_hash: STRING; semantics: LOWER(c.block_hash)
Relation `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.entity_labels_v1` (view)
  - address: STRING
  - chain_id: INTEGER
  - primary_label: STRING
  - owner: STRING
  - category: STRING
  - concept_class: STRING
  - address_role: STRING
  - aliases: STRING
  - confidence: STRING
  - verified_date: DATE
  - sources: RECORD
  - dictionary_sha256: STRING
Relation `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_token_transfers`(start_date DATE, end_date DATE)
  - all fields of token_transfer_facts, plus label columns from_{primary_label,owner,category,concept_class,address_role,confidence}, to_{primary_label,owner,category,concept_class,address_role,confidence}, token_{primary_label,owner,category,concept_class,address_role,confidence}
Relation `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.labeled_transactions`(start_date DATE, end_date DATE)
  - all fields of transaction_facts, plus label columns from_{primary_label,owner,category,concept_class,address_role,confidence}, to_{primary_label,owner,category,concept_class,address_role,confidence}
Relation `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.token_dimension` (view)
  - address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(tok.address)
  - symbol: STRING
  - name: STRING
  - decimals: INTEGER; semantics: SAFE_CAST(tok.decimals AS INT64)
Relation `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.token_transfer_facts`(start_date DATE, end_date DATE)
  - transaction_hash: STRING; semantics: LOWER(tt.transaction_hash)
  - log_index: INTEGER
  - block_timestamp: TIMESTAMP
  - block_number: INTEGER
  - block_hash: STRING; semantics: LOWER(tt.block_hash)
  - token_address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(tt.token_address)
  - from_address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(tt.from_address)
  - to_address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(tt.to_address)
  - value_raw: STRING
  - value_bignumeric: BIGNUMERIC; semantics: SAFE_CAST(tt.value AS BIGNUMERIC)
  - value_cast_valid: BOOLEAN; semantics: tt.value IS NOT NULL AND SAFE_CAST(tt.value AS BIGNUMERIC) IS NOT NULL
  - is_erc20: BOOLEAN
  - is_erc721: BOOLEAN
  - token_symbol: STRING
  - token_name: STRING
  - token_decimals: INTEGER; semantics: SAFE_CAST(tok.decimals AS INT64)
  - normalized_amount: BIGNUMERIC; semantics: CASE WHEN c.is_erc20 IS TRUE AND COALESCE(c.is_erc721, FALSE) IS FALSE AND SAFE_CAST(tok.decimals AS INT64) BETWEEN 0 AND 38 THEN SAFE_DIVIDE(SAFE_CAST(tt.value AS BIGNUMERIC), POW(BIGNUMERIC '10', SAFE_CAST(tok.decimals AS INT64))) END
Relation `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts`(start_date DATE, end_date DATE)
  - transaction_hash: STRING; semantics: LOWER(t.hash)
  - transaction_index: INTEGER
  - block_timestamp: TIMESTAMP
  - block_number: INTEGER
  - block_hash: STRING; semantics: LOWER(t.block_hash)
  - from_address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(t.from_address)
  - to_address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(t.to_address)
  - value_wei: NUMERIC
  - gas_limit: INTEGER
  - gas_price_wei: INTEGER
  - receipt_gas_used: INTEGER
  - receipt_status: INTEGER
  - is_success: BOOLEAN; semantics: t.receipt_status = 1
  - receipt_contract_address: STRING; semantics: LOWER(t.receipt_contract_address)
  - transaction_type: INTEGER

APPROVED JOINS
- fact_address_to_entity (left): block_facts.beneficiary_address, contract_dimension.address, token_transfer_facts.from_address, token_transfer_facts.to_address, token_transfer_facts.token_address, transaction_facts.from_address, transaction_facts.to_address = entity_labels_v1.address
- transaction_to_block (inner): transaction_facts.block_number = block_facts.block_number, transaction_facts.block_hash = block_facts.block_hash
- transaction_to_contract (inner): transaction_facts.to_address = contract_dimension.address
- transfer_to_contract (left): token_transfer_facts.token_address = contract_dimension.address
- transfer_to_token (left): token_transfer_facts.token_address = token_dimension.address
- transfer_to_transaction (inner): token_transfer_facts.transaction_hash = transaction_facts.transaction_hash, token_transfer_facts.block_number = transaction_facts.block_number, token_transfer_facts.block_hash = transaction_facts.block_hash

- :ValidatorAccount: A label can attribute an account, but block miner alone does not prove validator identity.
- :hasReceiptStatus: BigQuery stores receipt status as nullable INTEGER and the relation derives a nullable BOOLEAN.
- :hasConfidenceScore: The accepted dictionary has categorical confidence; no numeric score is fabricated.
- :hasMiner: The source miner field is exposed as beneficiary/fee recipient, not validator identity.

QUERY RULES
- Return exactly one read-only GoogleSQL query and nothing else: no prose, comments or semicolon.
- Use only the managed relations above with their fully qualified names in backticks.
- Call parameterized relations with DATE literals, e.g.
  `nl2sparql-thesis.nl2sparql_analytics.transaction_facts`(DATE '2026-06-01', DATE '2026-06-08').
- Date windows are half-open [start_date, end_date), at most 31 days, inside 2026-05-31..2026-07-01.
- Name every output column explicitly; SELECT * is not allowed.
- Filter named entities and entity classes through entity_labels_v1 (owner, concept_class),
  never by guessing addresses.
